SITE COUNT 18 -> 24: the park page says '24 50amp electric campsites' (4 in 2007 + 20 added); the activity block says '18 total campsites'. NAIP shows roughly 20-24 pads in three groups (north loop, south spur, by the west pond). Wrote 24 from the park page.

WATERFRONT: not waterfront stands. River: the West Nishnabotna here is ~13-18 m wide (creek width under the ~30 m line); the north loop's top pads (~41.5711,-95.3305) back onto a ~20 m continuous treeline before the bank, so no on-water value and no sightline. West pond: ~1.8 ha (~4.5 acres) of open water by dark-pixel count, and the county itself calls these 'sandpit fishing ponds', so it is a pond. Five angled pads off a gravel lot at ~41.5692,-95.3292 (Campsite #1 is 'closest campsite to the fishing pier on the west pond') sit ~35-50 m from the shore across mowed grass that carries the fishing-pier walkway and shore fishing (day use). Day use between and no pond-view value, so not waterfront rather than pond. A ground photo of those pads could reopen it.
